pipeline.name: weekly-content-gap-analysis
pipeline.description: Weekly content gap analysis — discover missing topics, write articles, publish

parent.title: [{{date}}] Content gap analysis
description: End-to-end pipeline: discover content gaps → prioritize → write articles → publish.
1. When SEO Expert finishes gap research: review the 10-15 gaps, then unblock Growth Analyst
2. When Growth Analyst finishes prioritization: review the top 5 scored gaps, approve the top 2-3 for production. Unblock SEO Expert for detailed briefs.
3. When SEO Expert finishes SEO briefs: review briefs quality, then unblock Copywriter
4. When Copywriter finishes articles + PRs: unblock Frontend Designer
5. When Designer finishes images: unblock Legal Expert
6. When Legal approves: proceed to merge (your task)
7. After merge + deploy: unblock SEO Expert for IndexNow submit
8. When IndexNow confirms: close this parent task
- Maximum 2-3 articles per run (supplements daily content, doesn't replace it)
- Prefer topics that fill genuine gaps (no existing article) over optimization of existing content
- Prioritize topics with proven search demand from GSC data

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Content gap research — competitor and query analysis
description: Discover content topics where search demand exists but Superdots has no article.
Look for: queries where we get impressions but the landing page is a POOR MATCH (wrong article ranking). These mean we need a DEDICATED article for that query.
Check these key competitors for content gaps: zapier.com/blog, hubspot.com/blog, clickup.com/blog, notion.so/blog, jasper.ai/blog.
For each competitor, search their recent AI content:
For key target queries, use top-results to see who's winning:
node scripts/tools/searxng.mjs top-results "best AI tools for [department]" --limit 5 --json
Check their top-ranking content. For each topic they cover well, verify if Superdots has equivalent coverage by checking our blog directory.
Superdots covers 9 departments: engineering, marketing, sales, hr, finance, operations, legal, customer-support, design.
For each department, count articles and identify thin areas. Check GSC for queries in underserved departments.
node scripts/tools/searxng.mjs news "AI workplace tools" --time week --json
node scripts/tools/searxng.mjs news "AI business automation" --time week --json
Identify emerging AI use cases with growing search interest.
Post as a comment with 10-15 gaps, each in this format:
- **Discovery method**: query mining / competitor / department audit / trending
- **Current Superdots coverage**: none / partial (article X covers it tangentially)
- **Recommended article type**: guide / tutorial / listicle / comparison
- **Competitor benchmark**: <top result URL and what they cover>
2. @mention **@Content Manager**: "Gap research complete — X gaps identified, ready for prioritization"

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Prioritize content gaps by traffic potential
description: Score and rank the gaps from SEO Expert's research by realistic traffic potential.
## Step 1 — Collect engagement and performance data
## Step 2 — Score each gap (1-5 per dimension)
| **Competition feasibility** | Top results are DR 80+ authority sites | Top results are small blogs/forums |
| **Content-market fit** | Niche/technical topic | Core audience: non-technical professionals using AI |
- Which content clusters already have traction in GSC? Gaps ADJACENT to strong clusters score +20 bonus.
- Which departments drive the most Umami engagement? Gaps in high-engagement departments score +10 bonus.
- Does this gap fill a cluster hole? (e.g., we have 5 HR articles but miss 'AI employee scheduling') Score +15 bonus.
Post as a comment, top 5 only:
- **Recommended priority**: this week / next week / backlog
2. @mention **@Content Manager**: "Prioritization complete — top 5 gaps ranked, ready for brief approval"

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Full SEO briefs for approved content gaps
description: Create full SEO briefs for the 2-3 gaps approved by Content Manager.
## Step 1 — Check which gaps were approved
Read Content Manager's comments on [{{gap_prioritization.identifier}}](/issues/{{gap_prioritization.identifier}}) for which gaps to brief.
## Step 2 — Deep keyword research per approved gap
## Step 3 — Write brief per article (same format as daily content briefs)
Post as a comment with this structure for each article:
- H2: FAQ (4-5 questions targeting People Also Ask)
- **Internal links**: link TO these existing articles: [list slugs]
- **Competitor analysis**: top 3 results cover X, Y, Z — we should cover all plus W
2. @mention **@Content Manager**: "SEO briefs ready for X article(s) — review and unblock Copywriter"
Content Manager approval of prioritized gaps from [{{gap_prioritization.identifier}}](/issues/{{gap_prioritization.identifier}}).

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Write gap analysis articles and open PRs
description: Write full articles based on SEO briefs from gap analysis.
## For each article in the briefs (from [{{seo_briefs.identifier}}](/issues/{{seo_briefs.identifier}})):
Use SearXNG for fact-checking and research:
- [ ] Frontmatter complete: title, description, pubDate (today), author, department, useCase, tags, imageHint
- [ ] Internal links to related articles (from brief)
- [ ] Practical, actionable content — no fluff, no corporate jargon
--body "New article from weekly content gap analysis."
1. Post all PR URLs as a comment
